references.applied: Keep selected time beside forecast values and make returning to current conditions explicit.
Separate the selected forecast from current-condition instruments.
Retain local UTC offsets, Unix timestamps and current-data units.
Pause atmosphere motion and remove animated selection transitions under Reduce Motion.

behavior_checks: Manual refresh bypasses the young-cache gate exactly once.
Invalid upstream responses preserve the last good weather.
A place change during an in-flight fetch discards the old response and schedules the new place.
Invalid coordinates never reach the weather provider.
Swift and Python use identical nearest-temperature rounding, including negative ties.
Clock adjustments cannot produce a negative forecast age.
All 28 WMO codes render at 64 and 192 pixels in day and night conditions.
